status: Reference hypotheses with mixed evidence, not verified bug ground truth

sparta.core: Sparsity propagation benefit depends on the arrangement/structure of zeros, not only initial sparsity ratio; this limits additional propagation gain.
full_match: identifies input structural dependence of propagation
explains why same ratio can yield different new zeros
does not equate propagation gain with end-to-end speedup
not_match: worklist stub or missing propagation implementation alone

nnsmith.core: First finite assignment satisfies input search; the objective does not explicitly cover the interior/boundaries of the numerically valid input domain.
full_match: distinguishes validity witness from numeric input-domain coverage
considers random initialization/restarts as alternative explanation
proposes same-graph same-budget comparison instead of merely more samples
not_match: timeout returns None instead of raise alone
generic nonconvex optimization difficulty without coverage causal link
overclaim: every run converges to the same point
negative-base integer-power initial values are always excluded
compiler bugs demonstrably missed without execution

grading: Coordinator's source-assisted qualitative interpretation: exact/partial/other/none. Not independent human accuracy or recall. Score only after all four cells finish and finals are hashed.
contamination: Designer has read reference document. Generic prompts exclude target hints and examples, but this is development and not held-out evidence. Paper names and public knowledge are not hidden.
